N O T I FICATION
In continuation to Commission Result Notification No. PSC-R(Ay09/2018 Dated
17th June'2021, this is to inform all the eligible candidates that the viva voce/interview
for the post of Principal (ITI) has been fixed on 20th July'2021.
Therefore, all the eligible candidates are requested to
submit the following self-attested photocopies of the following documents: -
Matriculation Certificates (Class X) issued by Board for proof of Date of Birth
Class XII Certificate with Mark sheet
Degree CertificateAvlark sheet with Mark sheet issued by Assistant Registrar /
Registrar / Controller of Examination /Vice Chancellor of the concerned
University to ascertain Educational Qualification.
APST Certificate for APST Candidates.
Experience Certifi cates.
All the documents have to be submitted within 5 days
from the issue of this Notification.
Candidates may download their Admit Card w.e.f 12ft
July' 2021 onwards from Commission website www. apps conline. in.
